summary: Wake-word JARVIS + Picovoice Porcupine PREVIEW_SIMULATION integration verified end-to-end. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): engine-status-card renders with title 'PREVIEW SIMULATION MODE', wake word 'JARVIS', key status 'PLACEHOLDER'; env-hint-box (amber) references '/app/frontend/.env' + '/app/WAKE_WORD_SETUP.md'; trigger-jarvis-btn appends a new wake-log entry with 'JARVIS detected' + confidence ~97% + current time, triggers the green engine-status-card pulse, and pushes a WAKE_WORD_DETECTED tier-1 executed row into the Commands tab; Background Listener Service card also references JARVIS; no lingering 'HEY ASSISTANT' text anywhere in the body. Regression: online-mode-switch flips amber 'ONLINE MODE ON' header badge, sim-online-search-btn opens online-query-result-modal and returns a real 707-char Gemini 3 Flash answer for 'quantum computing', Privacy DB export-audit-btn opens audit-export-modal with RECORDS=6 / ENGINE=v1 / SIGNED AT and JSON preview. Backend: 10/11 pytest cases green (search/meaning/knowledge query, empty-query 400, history GET, offline/status air-gap vs online, audit/export shape, status regression); the 1 failure is a KNOWN parallel-race artifact in test_history_delete_clears_ledger — pytest-xdist gw0 inserts a query while gw1 asserts the delete emptied the ledger. Not a backend bug. All 6 requested endpoints functional.

minor.issue: test_history_delete_clears_ledger flakes under pytest-xdist parallel workers because another worker inserts a query between DELETE and the follow-up GET. Not a real endpoint bug (DELETE returns correct deleted count). Consider running that test class serialised (@pytest.mark.serial / -p no:xdist) or restructuring the assertion to check delete count only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' repeatedly. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Reference: likely in shared card/modal StyleSheets (search 'shadow' + 'pointerEvents' props across /app/frontend/src).

action_items: (Low) Fix the flaky parallel delete test in /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_offline.py — either mark it serial or assert only on delete count, not on the follow-up empty GET.
(Low) Replace deprecated React Native Web style props ('shadow*' → 'boxShadow', props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: wakeWordEngine.ts abstraction is clean: PLACEHOLDER detection, listener list, and [NATIVE_IMPL] block are well-documented and correctly gated. Emit-based interface means the same downstream flow runs in both PREVIEW_SIMULATION and NATIVE_PORCUPINE modes.
index.tsx wires startEngine() + onWakeWord() in a single useEffect with cleanup returning the unsubscribe — no listener leak risk on tab remount.
/app/WAKE_WORD_SETUP.md gives the correct 3-line swap path and covers Android permissions + iOS NSMicrophoneUsageDescription for post-Publish activation.
Backend server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id in every projection ({"_id": 0}) and uses env vars for MONGO_URL / DB_NAME / EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. No hardcoded secrets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all wake-word tests + all requested regressions

seed_data_creation: Pytest suite creates a handful of online_query_logs rows and a TEST_ status check. Frontend TRIGGER button appends in-memory wake logs + commands (no DB writes).
